# Quarterly Community Contributor Ladder Review

This is the public tracking issue for the quarterly Flutter Contributor Ladder review.
Review criteria are defined in [LADDER.md](../../docs/LADDER.md).

## 1. 🎉 Recommended Promotions & New Community Joiners
*(Generated automatically by `dart run tool/quarterly_audit.dart --community`)*

> [!NOTE]
> If you are invited to join the ladder or promoted to a new tier above, please reply in this thread to accept and share your **Discord username** (if you do not already have the Discord team member role) so we can grant you team member channel access.

## 2. ✅ Active Role Retention
*(Generated automatically by `dart run tool/quarterly_audit.dart --community`)*

*(Generated automatically by `dart run tool/quarterly_audit.dart --community`)*

## 4. 📋 Callout for Unscripted & Qualitative Contributions
> [!IMPORTANT]
> If you have contributions that automated tracking does not index (issue triage, repro verification, [RFCs](https://github.com/flutter/rfc), design docs, mentoring), please reply in this thread with details before the 30-day grace period concludes.
